verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken structure: the left half is an empty blurred background panel, the Quillbrook product bag has shrunk to a tiny thumbnail at the bottom next to an equally tiny logo, and the CTA sits above the headline, which reverses the reading order. A is slightly better because its headline breaks cleanly ('Your coffee, / on repeat') and lines up with the body copy. B leaves 'repeat' alone on its own line, runs the headline nearly to the right edge, and starts it further left than the body copy, so the two edges don't line up.
